text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High tail latency detected for /generate-stream (p95 & p99 breaching) — auto-escalation triggered. Rule: streaming_tail_latency. Current: p95=1.2s p99=6.4s, error rate up 2.1%. Affected region: us-west-2.

alice: ack, i'm oncall. looking at traces and kv-cache metrics now. paging: ben, carmen — can you join?

ben: joining. seeing a big uptick in kv eviction_rate on the serving cluster (svc-gen-01..05). eviction count spiked ~x7 in the last 10m. suspect cache fragmentation / prefill pressure.

carmen: on my way. any immediate customer reports?

emily: we have two support tickets flagged as "streaming stalls" from large enterprise customers on dedicated clusters. not yet P1 but could degrade quickly.

ben: quick snapshot from node metrics:```
kv_cache_hits: 82.1%
kv_cache_evictions_per_min: 112 -> 780
kv_prefill_inflight: 240 -> 1200
decoder_mem_usage: 68% -> 45%
socket_queue_len: 4 -> 73
average_gen_latency_ms: 420 -> 1200
```

ben: note the imbalance: prefill jobs increased massively relative to decode activity. Prefill filling cold prefixes aggressively and causing fragmentation + frequent evictions. tail requests hitting misses and falling back to full decode, causing stalls.

alice: hypothesis: a recent rollout to allow more aggressive prefill for long-context models increased prefill concurrency. might be oversubscribing KV capacity. did we change prefill config earlier today?

carmen: yes — rollout 2026-03-10 02:14 UTC adjusted `prefill_concurrency_limit` from 200 to 800 for xlong models (PR #4512).

ben: that lines up. also seeing `kv_seg_free_pool` fragmentation high on nodes: many small free segments unable to satisfy new prefills so eviction churn goes up.

emily: customers impacted: [AcmeCorp-prod], [Nimbus-Search], [EduLabs]. notes from support: streaming stalls, partial tokens then long gap.

ben: immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback prefill concurrency change (safe but disruptive), 2) lower prefill limit at runtime via admin API (less disruptive), 3) increase kv cache memory on cluster (slow), 4) enable fallback to smaller-context model for streaming (works per-app).

alice: let's do the least disruptive first: reduce prefill concurrency on affected serving nodes via admin endpoint and throttle prefill queue. then watch p95/p99. if not improved in 5-10m, revert rollout.

ben: executing admin command on svc-gen-01..05:```
POST http://admin-usw2.internal/kv/config
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "prefill_concurrency_limit": 150
}
```

sre-bot: Deploy event: config change applied to svc-gen-01..05 by ben at 2105007002.

ben: change applied. also set temporary eviction_threshold to 0.85 -> 0.95 to reduce churn.```
curl -X POST http://admin-usw2.internal/kv/tuning -d '{"eviction_threshold":0.95}'
```

alice: metrics update (2m after): p95=640ms p99=2.1s socket_queue_len=18 kv_evictions_per_min=220 kv_prefill_inflight=420. improvement but still above SLO for p99.

carmen: looks better. continuing to monitor. should we notify customers? emily, propose message?

emily: draft message: "We're investigating streaming stalls affecting generation latency. Temporary mitigation applied; we expect improvement within 10m. We'll follow up with root cause and next steps." send to impacted customers now?

alice: yes, send now. mark tickets as being worked by oncall.

ben: root-cause triage notes: prefills creating many ephemeral small segments causing fragmentation. eviction churn increases, free memory unusable for larger entries — so decode path suffers more tail latency. Need longer-term: smarter prefill shaping (size-aware prefill), KV compaction, and limits per model type.

carmen: short-term follow-ups: 1) keep prefill limit reduced to 150 until next maintenance window, 2) trigger background compaction on affected nodes with low traffic, 3) create alert for prefill_vs_decode_ratio > 3.5.

alice: initiated compaction command on svc-gen-03 (low traffic):```
POST http://admin-usw2.internal/kv/compact?node=svc-gen-03
```

sre-bot: Compaction job queued on svc-gen-03 at 2105007178. ETA 90s.

ben: monitoring timeline: p95=520ms p99=1.4s now. eviction rate trending down. socket queues draining.

alice: good. i'll prepare a short incident summary for handoff to next oncall. ben/carmen, any immediate docs or runbook updates?

ben: add entries to runbook: "prefill can overload KV pool — steps: reduce `prefill_concurrency_limit`, bump eviction_threshold, trigger compaction, consider rolling revert of prefill rollout."

carmen: done — updated runbook page and linked PRs + timeline.

alice: handing off to carmen for the overnight watch. last state: mitigations applied, customers notified, metrics improving but still in high-warning. please escalate if p99 > 3s or eviction_rate > 400/min.

carmen: taking handoff. I have contact list for AcmeCorp & Nimbus. will check again in 15m and report.

emily: customer update sent. support marked incidents as "investigating — mitigation applied".

sre-bot: ALERT RESOLVED: streaming_tail_latency back to warning (no longer firing) at 2105007349.

carmen: thanks team. will keep monitoring and open a follow-up postmortem ticket to cover code/regression and better prefill heuristics.

ben: for postmortem, include benchmarks for prefill sizing + fragmentation simulation. also consider tuning allocator to prefer larger contiguous segments.

alice: nice work. closing this Slack thread once handoff confirmed. :thumbsup:
